podcast-dannyjones-70Vrvg4dUHQ:
Physicist Jack Sarfatti claims a long, strange career at the edges of funded science. On Danny Jones's podcast he argues that UFOs are driven by minds. He also argues that warp drive and time travel belong in serious conversation. Sarfatti presents himself as a CIA-funded researcher who has worked on these questions for decades.

Jones follows him through childhood encounters, Cold War money, and the physics Sarfatti says the academy refuses to touch. Mainstream physicists treat his claims with deep skepticism, and nothing here is established science. The episode's appeal is the man himself: a credentialed, combative theorist telling his version of a hidden history of American physics. It is preserved as his account, for listeners to enjoy and to check.
podcast-joerogan-y9KNLlRE2HQ:
Kickboxing champion Rico Verhoeven headlines Rogan's MMA Show number 183. The Dutch heavyweight ruled his sport for years. Fans call him the king of kickboxing with good cause.

Rogan explores how Verhoeven trains, eats, and stays on top so long. They compare kickboxing with mixed martial arts in craft and pay. Verhoeven shares tales of huge arena fights in Europe. The episode gives American fight fans a close look at a star their scene respects but rarely hosts, in his own calm words. His size and skill make a rare pairing.
